label: R6Kgamma ori
note: The R6K gamma origin of replication: the 389 bp segment from base 1 of the sequenced autonomously replicating R6K segment, carrying the seven 22-bp pi iterons; replicates only where the R6K pi protein (pir) is supplied in trans.

provenance.sequence_source: R6K gamma origin; 100% identical to R6K plasmid GenBank LT827129 (complement of 26034-26422) and to bases 1-389 of GenBank V00320 (Stalker et al. 1982; reverse complement) except V00320 base 30 (G; C here). Contains 281 of the 282 bp of the gamma origin deposited as GenBank M11000 (McEachern et al. 1985). Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 430 bp record whose first 31 bp were pBR322 tet DNA (bases 3-31 = pBR322 380-409, inside tet) and whose last 10 bp were 3 further R6K bases and 7 bp that do not continue the R6K sequence.

functional_claims.label: Spans bases 1-389 of the sequenced autonomously replicating R6K segment (V00320); contains the seven 22-bp direct repeats (pi-binding iterons) and the region adjacent to them that McEachern et al. found required for origin function. The boundary is the conventional span; no truncation series defining its ends was consulted.

source.quote: Members of this bank contain single or multiple mutations in the seven direct repeats and the flanking sequences in the gamma origin.

provenance.from: pairwise alignment to GenBank V00320, M11000, LT827129
